evaluation_role: retrospective historical evaluation; previous test outcomes are already known

adaptive.quality_guard: finite input; candidate trained on text; strict-source scenario rejects unverifiable sources

boundary: Deep epochs chosen using train-only fits on calibration, then refit train+cal. Decision/test never enter deep early stopping. Adaptive weights use only fully matured prior decision/test origins; no current or future target access. No route changes to rounds 8-12. New gates are exploratory and do not claim family-wise error control. No new blind confirmation or guaranteed safety claim.
